rarity_rule: rarity <= 3.3 用 rare 句式；其余用 common 句式，换角度夸，不说普通

praise.zh: 一千层心事叠得整整齐齐，不说话也镇得住场。
praise.en: A thousand neat layers of thought. Quiet, and still the heaviest thing on the table.

poke.zh: 别人回你一个“哦”，你能复盘到天亮。
poke.en: Someone texts "k" and you replay it till sunrise.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 1.5% 的人是这块千层。
rarity_line.en: Only 1.5% of people are this mille-feuille.

praise.zh: 层层精准，一上桌就是今晚的主角。
praise.en: Precise to the last layer. The moment you land, you're the main event.

poke.zh: 聚餐切蛋糕，你都想先排个甘特图。
poke.en: You'd make a Gantt chart for cutting the cake.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 1.8% 的人能撑起这块歌剧院。
rarity_line.en: Only 1.8% of people can carry an opera cake.

praise.zh: 浓度拉满，走一步已经算好后面十步。
praise.en: Full-strength dark chocolate. Ten moves ahead before anyone takes a bite.

poke.zh: 谁动你的配方，你能记他三个学期。
poke.en: Touch your recipe and you'll remember it for three semesters.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 2.1% 的人是这块黑巧挞。
rarity_line.en: Only 2.1% of people are this dark chocolate tart.

praise.zh: 行走的情绪价值，有你的局从不冷场。
praise.en: Walking good vibes. No party goes cold when you're there.

poke.zh: 操心全场开不开心，散场比主办还累。
poke.en: You check everyone's having fun, then go home more tired than the host.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 2.5% 的人是这块草莓蛋糕。
rarity_line.en: Only 2.5% of people are this strawberry shortcake.

praise.zh: 又野又有梗，甜里带苦，还有点酒劲。
praise.en: Wild, witty, sweet with a bitter kick and a little booze.

poke.zh: 凌晨两点不睡，在评论区跟陌生人较真。
poke.en: 2am, still arguing with a stranger in the comments. For fun.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 3.2% 的人是这杯提拉米苏。
rarity_line.en: Only 3.2% of people are this tiramisu.

praise.zh: 脑子八百马力，冷笑话一刀切中要害。
praise.en: A brain on overdrive, and deadpan jokes that hit dead center.

poke.zh: 消息在脑子里回过了，手机里没有。
poke.en: You replied in your head three days ago. Your phone never got it.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 3.3% 的人是这块咖啡冻。
rarity_line.en: Only 3.3% of people are this coffee jelly.

praise.zh: 敢想敢冲，焦的那面都是你的勋章。
praise.en: Burnt on purpose and proud of it. First one in, every time.

poke.zh: 脑子还没开机，人已经冲进现场了。
poke.en: Your body's already there. Your brain is still loading.

rarity_line.zh: 100 个人里只有 4 个是这块巴斯克，懂的人都在抢。
rarity_line.en: Only 4 in 100 people are this Basque. The ones who know, fight for it.

praise.zh: 像云朵写的情诗，脑内自带一整个宇宙。
praise.en: A love letter written in clouds, with a whole universe inside.

poke.zh: 群里安静三秒，你就开始默默塌陷。
poke.en: Group chat goes quiet for three seconds and you start to deflate.

rarity_line.zh: 100 个人里只有 4 个是这份舒芙蕾，要趁热。
rarity_line.en: Only 4 in 100 people are this soufflé. Catch it while it's warm.

praise.zh: 表面波澜不惊，一出手就是硬核技能。
praise.en: Cool on top, quietly fixing what nobody else can.

poke.zh: 能回一个字，绝不打第二个。
poke.en: If one word works, you're not typing two.

rarity_line.zh: 100 个人里只有 5 个是这碗布丁，话少但靠谱。
rarity_line.en: Only 5 in 100 people are this crème caramel. Few words, all reliable.

praise.zh: 行走的多巴胺，连发呆都是彩色的。
praise.en: Walking dopamine. Even your daydreams come with sprinkles.

poke.zh: 一周开八个新坑，一个都没填完。
poke.en: Eight new hobbies this week. Zero finished.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.1% 的人都是快乐来源，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.1% of people are walking happiness. You're one of them.

praise.zh: 天生聚光灯，有你的地方就是派对。
praise.en: Born under the spotlight. Wherever you are, it's a party.

poke.zh: 嗨完三小时，原地化成一滩。
poke.en: Three hours at full blast, then a puddle on the sofa.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.5% 的人负责让夏天变好玩，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.5% of people make summer fun. You're one of them.

praise.zh: 靠谱到离谱，天塌了你先列清单。
praise.en: Ridiculously reliable. Sky falls, you make a checklist.

poke.zh: 催进度上瘾，群公告的标点你都要改。
poke.en: You'll fix the punctuation in the group announcement.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.7% 的人撑着所有小组作业，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.7% of people hold every group project together. You're one of them.

praise.zh: 审美从不翻车，日子被你过成了展览。
praise.en: Never a style miss. Your life looks like an exhibition.

poke.zh: 气场不对，立刻人间蒸发。
poke.en: Vibe feels off? You vanish without a trace.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.8% 的人负责让世界好看，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.8% of people keep the world beautiful. You're one of them.

praise.zh: 定海神针，准时稳定得让人安心。
praise.en: The rock everyone leans on. Always on time, always the same great taste.

poke.zh: 午饭换一家店，能别扭一整天。
poke.en: The lunch spot changed and it threw off your whole day.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 11.6% 的人在撑着这个世界正常运转，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 11.6% of people keep the world running on time. You're one of them.

praise.zh: 一口一个的暖阳，谁都被你照顾到了。
praise.en: Bite-sized sunshine. Somehow everyone feels looked after.

poke.zh: 连别人回的大拇指，你都要再回一个。
poke.en: You reply to a thumbs-up. With another thumbs-up.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 12.3% 的人负责让大家聚在一起，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 12.3% of people bring everyone together. You're one of them.

praise.zh: 恒温的安全感，总在细节处托住所有人。
praise.en: Always warm, quietly holding everyone together in the small details.

poke.zh: 嘴上说没事，其实已经撑到最后一口了。
poke.en: "No worries!" Said while running on the last crumb.

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 13.8% 的人离不开你，你是最多人的安心感。
rarity_line.en: 13.8% of people are you, and the rest can't live without you.
